svg.aria-label: What I do: Cloud & Infrastructure — The whole GCP estate as Terraform across dev, staging and prod, with daily drift detection. Led a zero-downtime move to a new GCP organization. White-label customer domains on Cloudflare for SaaS.; DevSecOps — Per-service pipelines, release candidates with smoke tests and one-step rollback, a preview environment per pull request. Semgrep, Trivy, TruffleHog and ZAP in CI; SOC 2 Type II readiness.; Observability & FinOps — Alerting, latency dashboards and on-call routing. Per-provider cost tracking in BigQuery, reconciling modelled AI spend against the cloud invoice, cost centres mapped to credit pricing.; Backend — Correctness where money and email are on the line: idempotent sends, credit-ledger conflict fixes, capacity-aware scheduling. A Python video engine that renders scenes in parallel and survives crashes.; Frontend — Cost-centre and AI-spend dashboards, server-rendered public microsite pages with no layout shift, and per-route error containment reported to PostHog.; AI engineering — An offline eval harness for the autonomous decider agent: golden scenarios, LLM-as-judge, prompt versioning and a CI gate that blocks regressions. LLM tracing on Langfuse.
